expr: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /sign in|log in|submit/i.test(x.textContent || '')); if (b) { b.click(); return 'clicked'; } return 'no button'; })()
(() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /^new$/i.test((x.textContent || '').trim())); if (b) { b.click(); return 'clicked New'; } return 'no New btn'; })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; return 'builder=' + (t.includes('TRIGGER') && t.includes('Agent')) + ' | stepCards=' + Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('ol li')).length + ' | addStepBtns=' + Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(b => /step$/i.test((b.textContent||'').trim())).length; })()

(() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /^create$/i.test((x.textContent || '').trim())); if (b) { b.click(); return 'clicked Create'; } return 'no create btn'; })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; const runBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /^run$/i.test((x.textContent || '').trim())); return 'saved=' + t.includes('Browser workflow') + ' | runDisabled=' + (runBtn ? runBtn.disabled : 'no-btn'); })()

(() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /^run$/i.test((x.textContent || '').trim())); if (b && !b.disabled) { b.click(); return 'clicked Run'; } return 'run btn disabled'; })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; return 'runStatus=' + (t.includes('failed') ? 'failed' : 'completed') + ' | okBadges=' + (t.match(/ok/g) || []).length + ' | stepCards=' + Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('ol li')).length; })()
